title: Happening
description: A gentle world event with choices. One file per happening in content/happenings/<id>.json.

trigger.description: The condition that makes the happening eligible.

chancePerMille.description: The chance per day, in per-mille, that an eligible happening occurs.

cooldownDays.description: Days before it can occur again.

options.description: The choices; at least one. Never harsh.

items.description: One choice: its effects, how long its modifiers last, and the locale key of its button label.

label.description: The locale key of the option's button label, such as happening.bountiful_catch.option.0.label; the linter (EVL007) requires it to exist in locale/en.

durationDays.description: For modifiers, how many days they last; 0 means they are permanent.

defaultOption.description: The index of the option applied if the player does not choose; must be less than the number of options.
